sections.html: Silver Dollars, which are the piranha relatives that eat mainly vegetable food, usually grow quite large, most species grow to over 20 cm, some to 40-60 cm long. The smallest known species is Metynnis lippincottianus. They are currently 8-12 cm long, more than 15 cm total length is not to be expected for this species.
M. lippincottianus is widespread in South America and occurs in Bolivia, Brazil, Ecuador, Colombia and French Guyana.
Males and females of sexually mature animals can be easily distinguished by the shape and colouring of the anal fin.
Metynnis species are free spawners without brood care.
M. lippincottianus differs from the similar, larger species M. maculatus by its more elongated body, M. maculatus is therefore more highbacked.
